name: vam-knowledge
description: Personal knowledge base worked as a loop: bootstrap and repair the vault contract, recall prior notes before re-solving a problem, capture durable repo-grounded knowledge, garden the vault as it decays, and map unfamiliar codebases through a structured level-by-level recon. Vault-agnostic: the target vault is resolved at runtime from references/vaults.md, and mounted by a separate vam-vault-* connector plugin.
